MOD-PM-01068 · Legon

Hourly history and forecast score

History and the forward forecast are both hourly. Each history hour is the mean of the readings logged in that hour. An hour is scored when the previous hour, within the past three hours, forecast it. MAE is the average miss. MBE is forecast minus actual, so a positive MBE means the forecast ran high. The home shelf shows only the latest hours.
